 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT st.store_id, sum(refund_net) ret, count(*) nr, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) dr FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
d AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(returns_net) rn, sum(net_sales) ns, count(*) n FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1)

FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN d USING(store_id) ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (
  SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2
), sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date IN (SELECT calendar_date FROM p) AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.store_id
), returns AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date IN (SELECT calendar_date FROM p) AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.store_id
)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales.net_sales_before_returns - coalesce(returns.returns_net, 0) DESC) AS rank,
       'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period,
       sales.store_id, cur.store_name,
       sales.net_sales_before_returns - coalesce(returns.returns_net, 0) AS net_sales
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN returns USING (store_id)
JOIN dim_store cur ON cur.store_id = sales.store_id AND cur.is_current
ORDER BY rank
